name: Spark Double
issue: The entire copy effect is missing. Oracle text has three clauses (may copy a creature/planeswalker you control; extra +1/+1 counter if creature or extra loyalty counter if planeswalker; isn't legendary) and the parse keeps only the first half of the middle clause -- a bare +1/+1 counter on itself, unconditional, with no copy effect at all. Compare Clone/Phantasmal Image/Clever Impersonator on the same oracle pattern ('may have this creature enter as a copy of X'), which all correctly emit a BecomeCopy effect. Labeled clean, 0 parse_warnings.

evidence.oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.

replacements.description: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.

note: Clone's BecomeCopy{target:Typed[Creature]} pattern is directly reusable for the 'may copy' clause, but the type-conditional counter branching (+1/+1 if creature XOR loyalty if planeswalker) and the legendary override have no precedent elsewhere in the corpus to build from safely. A partial patch that fixed only the copy clause while still silently dropping the counter/legendary clauses would trade one silent wrongness for another, so this stays flag-only pending either an upstream fix or a hand-verified full replacement chain.

name: Bond of Agony
issue: "As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life" parses to a Fixed cost of 0 life instead of a cost that scales with the X the caster chooses. The spell casts for free on the life-payment axis regardless of X, while its effect still references X. See corrections/CLASS-x-life-cost.md for the shared pattern across all 7 affected cards.

evidence.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
Each other player loses X life.

note: See corrections/CLASS-x-life-cost.md -- zero precedent anywhere in the corpus for a Variable/X node inside any cost's amount field, so the correct shape can't be inferred safely.
